texts.preamble: Mithun Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2020 Author: Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari Bench: Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari 1 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh Mcrc-49493-2019 (Mithun Sharma Vs. State of M.P.) Gwalior, Dated : 07/01/2020
texts.facts: The applicant has filed this second application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail. The first application was dismissed on merits vide order dated 15/11/2019 passed in MCRC No.43778/2019. The applicant apprehends his arrest in connection with Crime No.501/2019 registered at Police Station- Jaura, District- Morena for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 272, 273 of IPC read with Sections 51 and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. The allegation against the petitioner is that he was found manufacturing of Paneer and 90 kilograms of Paneer and three opened Tins in which 15 Lt. Refined Palm Kernel Oil have been stored in the shop of the applicant and that Refind Palm Kernel oil has been used for manufacturing of the spurious paneer.
texts.arguments: On the basis of aforesaid, crime has been registered against the applicant. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the matter and he is not concerned with the case directly or indirectly. It is also submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that FIR has been lodged against the applicant without waiting for the sample report. The applicant is the permanent resident of District- Morena. There is no likelihood of his absconsion, if he is granted the benefit of anticipatory bail. Learned Public Prosecutor for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection by contending that on the basis of the allegations and the material available on record, no case for grant of anticipatory bail is made out. It is also submitted by the learned counsel for the respondent/State that the investigation is pending and custodial interrogation may be required in the matter and the submission made by the counsel for the applicant has already been considered in previous bail application which was rejected by this Court.
